{{Quote|&hellip;What the blazes is that?"<br />"It's our destination, Lando. Our best hope of hurting the Empire as badly as they've hurt us. It's&mdash;''Bazarre!''|Lando Calrissian and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="marvel59" />}}
'''''Bazarre''''' was a large [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as a popular [[Black market/Legends|black market]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. Located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], ''Bazarre'' was owned by gunrunner [[Orion Ferret]], who fostered an environment where almost anything could be bought and sold aboard the station, including [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Ferret attempted to betray and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] over a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] deal aboard ''Bazarre'', but his plot was discovered and foiled.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Security is vital in running an operation like ''Bazarre'', and my guards occasionally get overzealous.|Orion Ferret|<ref name="marvel59" />}}
A massive [[Space station/Legends|space station]] with a distinct [[Color/Legends|gold]] exterior, ''Bazarre'' was known as a major market where seemingly anything could be bought and sold, and attracted a high number of visitors from many different [[Species/Legends|species]]. Trades illegal throughout many parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] were permitted on ''Bazarre''&mdash;[[Slavery/Legends|slave]] auctions were conducted openly on the trading floor, and there was at least one [[Spice/Legends|spice]] booth open on the station.<ref name="marvel59" /> However, most business conducted on ''Bazarre'' was actually legal, and it was frequented by the galaxy's rich.<ref name="ZT" /> The station held large Trade Shows that were highly attended by peoples from every corner of the galaxy, including representatives from the reclusive [[S'kytri]], who would sell trinkets and perform dramatic recreations of their [[Initiation Hunt]]s.<ref name="gamer1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>

Bazarre was especially renowned for its selection of high-tech explosives, including [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]]-made [[talking bomb]]s.<ref name="bespin">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespinmain|text=Bespin: Action Tidings|int=Bespin: Action Tidings}}</ref> The station's interiors were lavishly appointed, with owner [[Orion Ferret]]'s apartments being particularly luxurious. Ferret's quarters on ''Bazarre'' even had their own [[Prison/Legends|prison]], consisting of a [[spritzer]] unit meant to ensnare foes. Ferret put a heavy emphasis on security, operating a large force of guards that were known to sometimes get violent towards unknown visitors.<ref name="marvel59" />

==History==
{{Quote|By now, you hairy nuisance, your friends are gone. Nullified! Dead! While you, dear fellow, shall bring me a tidy profit on the auction block! And, I might add, there's not a thing you can do about it!|Orion Ferret, after imprisoning Chewbacca aboard ''Bazarre''|<ref name="marvel59" />}}
[[File:Bazarre_interior_MC58.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The interior of ''Bazarre''.]]
Centuries old by the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the space station known as ''Bazarre'' was known for generations as a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] and [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] of indeterminate origin. Although it had set up for business at several different locations, by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], it had become located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Mosu system]], on the edge of the [[Cademimu sector/Legends|Cademimu sector]].<ref name="ZT" /> By that time, ''Bazarre'' was owned and operated by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named Orion Ferret, a noted gunrunner with an untrustworthy reputation in underworld circles. Ferret controlled ''Bazarre'' with the help of a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] aide named [[P'Lor]], who monitored incoming messages using a [[Cybernetics/Legends|computer implant]] in his head. At the height of the war, ''Bazarre'' visited by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who arrived to finish brokering a deal with Ferret for four [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="marvel59" />

Ferret planned on swindling Calrissian and Skywalker, [[Death/Legends|killing]] them while keeping the valuable merchandise for himself, but his plans were discovered by their partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The furious [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] chased Ferret through ''Bazarre''{{'s}} corridors and captured the man, but Skywalker and Calrissian returned unharmed, cargo in tow, and convinced the Wookiee not to kill Ferret.<ref name="marvel59" /> ''Bazarre'' played host to many other sizable deals during this era, including [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] arms merchant [[Lernik De'Yago]]'s sale of the [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] and former Rebel medical transport ''[[Nova Whisper]]'' to an on-station [[Starship/Legends|starship]] dealer.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Bazarre'' first appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' 58]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel58">[[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' (1977) 58]]</ref> It went on to be the main setting of the [[Star Wars (1977) 59|following issue]] of the original [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'']] comic series.<ref name="marvel59" />
